verdict.headline: Amazon's cloud blowout confirms AI demand; bond market now prices a September rate hike
verdict.label: HOLD — 4 of 6 regime indicators breached entering August; SPX 7,490 (Day 2 above 7,380, BEARISH regime formally reversed); 30Y 5.28% (19-year high), September hike 82.4% (above 70% trigger), Brent $91, WTI $87; BTC $63,052 live (Gate 2 buffer $1,052); PLTR earnings AH Monday, NFP Friday Aug 7
verdict.rationale_short: Amazon's AWS quarter — $42.2B revenue, +37% YoY, fastest growth in 18 quarters — plus Alphabet Cloud's continued expansion gave the market the dual confirmation it needed: AI capex is generating real organic revenue at scale. SPX closed at 7,490 for a second consecutive session above 7,380, formally completing the BEARISH regime reversal. But the macro backdrop entering August is not clean: September rate hike probability sits at 82.4% — well above the 70% formal trigger — after Q2 ECI printed 0.9% QoQ (in-line), and the bond market treated neutral data as insufficient relief. The 30Y closed at 5.28%, a new 19-year high, with three FOMC dissents (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) for an immediate hike as the explicit policy signal. Brent is at $91 and WTI at $87, both well above formal triggers. AAPL's three simultaneous misses (services, China, Q4 guidance) introduce a quality-rotation question for the Nasdaq. BTC edged up overnight to $63,052 (Crypto.com 11:02 AM UTC) but retains only $1,052 of buffer above Gate 2. The week ahead is the next test: PLTR earnings AH Monday Aug 3 is the DoD-AI binary; July NFP Friday Aug 7 is the next rate-path data point and the most likely catalyst to move September probability materially.

Market consensus has shifted from 'one-quarter miss' to 'structural damage' — the $315 buyer-defense level failed to hold.

trade_setups.thesis: PLTR reports Q2 after the close Monday Aug 3. Options pricing ~15% swing. The DoD AI urgency thesis — reinforced by US retaliatory IRGC strikes and the ongoing US-Iran escalation trajectory — makes PLTR the most defense-AI leveraged large-cap into earnings. Key metrics: AIP commercial ARR growth rate, US government contract expansion, and any explicit DoD AI program disclosure. A beat on government revenue with raised guidance validates the thesis; a miss + September at 82.4% creates a dual headwind (fundamentals + multiple compression) with no near-term relief.
trade_setups.entry: Risk-defined exposure (options or small equity) into Monday close. $110-115 is the support zone on a miss; $140+ is the next resistance on a beat with DoD contract expansion.
trade_setups.invalidation: Government revenue deceleration or soft guidance removes the DoD spending thesis and neutralizes the geopolitical premium.

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high) extended +16bps on Friday even after ECI printed at consensus — the bond market is pricing FOMC policy, not data surprises. September probability is 82.4%; the three dissents (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) are the explicit forward guidance. July NFP (Aug 7) is the next regime-critical input: above 200k with any wage acceleration makes September near-certain and likely extends 30Y toward 5.35-5.40%; below 100k is the only clear reversal catalyst. The 5.00% level is the formal regime-breach recovery gate.
trade_setups.entry: 5.25-5.35% is the near-term extension zone. Watch 30Y within 15 minutes of 8:30 AM ET Friday Aug 7: above 5.32% confirms hot; below 5.10% signals reversal.
trade_setups.invalidation: Sub-100k NFP print with falling wages would clear the formal 30Y breach; September odds falling below 70% removes the second breached indicator.

trade_setups.thesis: Two consecutive Friday closes above 7,380 formally reversed the BEARISH designation. The level now functions as the August support that defines whether the reversal is sustained. PLTR earnings Monday and NFP Friday are the two nearest catalysts large enough to push SPX below 7,380 on a negative surprise. A fourth breach (SPX below 7,380) would reclassify the regime and require two new consecutive closes to recover.
trade_setups.entry: 7,380 is new support; 7,500+ sustained through NFP signals August momentum. Not a trading entry — a regime monitor.
trade_setups.invalidation: Any close below 7,380 re-activates the formal BEARISH regime classification.

bear_case: The BEARISH regime reversal is mechanical, not fundamental: SPX reclaimed 7,380 on one week of Big Tech earnings — MSFT and AMZN — not on a macro shift. September rate hike probability at 82.4% is fixed income's clearest policy signal, and a 30Y at 5.28% (new 19-year high) historically compresses Nasdaq forward multiples over a 3-6 month lag. The FOMC's 9-3 dissent (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) is the explicit warning that the hawks are close to winning the next meeting. AAPL's structural miss and AMD's −7-8% on a broad rally day signal that rate-driven multiple compression is already differentiating. BTC retained only $1,052 above Gate 2 ($62,000) entering the weekend; a risk-off event or a hot NFP Friday would close the buffer. If July NFP on Aug 7 prints above 200k, September becomes near-certain, 30Y extends toward 5.35-5.40%, and SPX loses 7,380 on Day 1 of the August data week. The read does not hold if SPX closes below 7,380.
